name: quarterplan-excel
description: Quarterly capacity and delivery planning for IT teams in Excel

scripts.build: node scripts/check_environment.mjs && node scripts/build_quarter_planning_step1.mjs && node scripts/create_quarter_planning_xlsm.mjs
scripts.normalize: node scripts/check_environment.mjs && node scripts/normalize_workbook_design.mjs outputs/quarter_planning_step1.xlsx outputs/quarter_planning_step2.xlsm
scripts.sanitize:assets: node scripts/check_environment.mjs && node scripts/sanitize_workbook_metadata.mjs "assets/Шаблон Экспресс оценки.xlsx"
scripts.verify: node scripts/check_environment.mjs && node scripts/build_quarter_planning_step1.mjs && node scripts/create_quarter_planning_xlsm.mjs && node scripts/verify_static_contracts.mjs
scripts.verify:release: node scripts/check_environment.mjs && node scripts/build_release.mjs && node scripts/verify_public_release.mjs
